51589174.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human Avi/10-his tagged GCase (40 to 536 residues) expressed baculovirus expression system in Sf9 cells in assessed as dissociation constant by isothermal titration calorimetry analysis
51589174.references_previous: Hopkins, A. L.; Groom, C. R.; Alex, A. Ligand efficiency: a useful metric for lead selection. Drug Discov Today 2004, 9 (10), 430–431.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal Titra: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC). GCase protein was provided by in-house purification. ITC experiments were performed on a Malvern PEAQ-ITC at 25 °C in a buffer comprising 50 mM Hepes, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, and 5% DMSO at pH 7.5. Titrations were performed using 12 × 3 μL injections with a 150 s spacing between each injection and a stirring speed of 750 rpm. ITC data analyses were performed with Origin 7.0 using the “One Set of Sites” model.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. Ribbon representation of the X-ray crystal structure of GCase overlaid with the locations of the 13 sites identified by X-ray crystallography. All Kd values were measured using ITC. Representative fragment hits in each site are displayed as Connolly surfaces (yellow). The location of the two sites prioritised for further investigation are sites A (cyan) and B (magenta). The active site with known ligand isofagomine is in red.
original_paragraph.Table 1 footnote: aValues were determined by ITC using GCase protein (Uniprot P04062). bData are n = 1. cLigand efficiency (LE) values are in kcal per heavy atom and were calculated according to the Hopkins formula (LE = ΔG/NHA = −RT ln Kd/NHA).15 For all assay details, see the Experimental Section.
original_paragraph.Table 2 footnote: aValues were determined by ITC using GCase protein (Uniprot P04062). bData are n = 1. cLigand efficiency (LE) values are in kcal per heavy atom and were calculated according to the Hopkins formula (LE = ΔG/NHA = −RT ln Kd/NHA).15 For all assay details see Experimental Section.
